classification.source_level_rationale: created in the course of the activity it documents: This is an administrative file documenting parliamentary deliberations on legislative amendments.
classification.resume: This is a sound recording of the National Council debate on 9 October 1992 concerning the adaptation of Swiss federal law to the European Economic Area (Eurolex), specifically the amendment of the Federal Law on Supplementary Benefits to Old-Age, Survivors' and Invalidity Insurance. It captures parliamentary proceedings rather than a legislative text or news report.
